emma-cs: Heads-up — multiple onboarding customers reporting promo code not applying (SPRING50). ~25 accounts. Example: acct_4721 getting 'promo_not_started' even though campaign looks active in console.

jay-support: Can you paste the API response and campaign config for one affected account?

emma-cs: API call and response from the customer:```POST /v1/promos/redeem
Body: {
  "code": "SPRING50",
  "account_id": "acct_4721"
}
Response 400
{ "error": "promo_not_started", "message": "Redemption window not started" }```

emma-cs: Campaign config from admin API:```GET /v1/promos/SPRING50
{
  "id": "SPRING50",
  "start_date": "2026-03-16T00:00:00",
  "end_date": "2026-03-31T23:59:59",
  "timezone": "America/New_York",
  "redemption_limit": 0,
  "per_customer_limit": 0
}```

jay-support: Two suspicious things: start_date has no explicit TZ offset and both limits are 0. How does our service interpret 0?

sanjay-eng: Repro & quick dive: our promo-service parses start_date as a naive local-time when coming from UI but redemption check canonicalizes to UTC using server default. In this case start_date parsed -> 2026-03-16T04:00:00Z (server UTC) but customer in EDT expects 00:00 EDT -> which is 04:00Z. If now is 02:12Z the check returns NOT_STARTED. Also found bug: codebase treats redemption_limit/per_customer_limit==0 as "zero allowed" (i.e., block), not unlimited. So two issues: tz parsing + 0 semantics.

sanjay-eng: Relevant log snippet:
```[2026-03-16T02:12:01Z] promo-service: check_window promo=SPRING50 parsed_start=2026-03-16T04:00:00Z now=2026-03-16T02:12:01Z -> status=NOT_STARTED
[2026-03-16T02:12:01Z] promo-service: check_limits per_customer_limit=0 interpreted=0 -> reject
```

jay-support: Oof. That explains both the 'not started' errors and immediate blocking once redeemed elsewhere. Expected behaviour: 0 should mean unlimited.

mia-billing: For immediate customer relief I can issue one-off trial credits. Send me list of account IDs and credit amounts you want applied. I can do a bulk adjustment.

emma-cs: Sending list privately to mia-billing PM. For transparency, we'll offer 14 extra trial days + manual credit redeem for SPRING50 customers.

sanjay-eng: Mitigation plan: 1) Hotfix parsing to respect campaign.timezone when start_date has no TZ (treat naive as campaign.timezone) and interpret 0 as unlimited. 2) Quick patch to treat existing promos with per_customer_limit==0 as unlimited, unless explicitly flagged. 3) Backfill: run a script to re-evaluate blocked redemptions between start_date and now and enqueue auto-redeem for affected accounts. 4) Add unit tests for DST edge cases. I'll open PR and aim to push to staging in ~30m, prod in ~2h after smoke tests.

oliver-product: Also add a UI warning when a campaign's start_date is naive vs timezone set, and change the creation flow to require explicit timezone or to display the equivalent UTC window. Add tooltip for "0 means unlimited" in the form. Ticketed.

campaign-bot: deploy-bot: promo-service hotfix build queued (v3.4.7-hotfix). CI: ✅.

jay-support: I'll draft the customer message template for the affected accounts: apology, explanation that promo should have been valid, actions taken (manual grant + fix rolling out).

emma-cs: Thanks — please cc me on the messages. I'll track impacted accounts and confirm credits applied. Closing loop once backfill finishes. :thumbsup:
